$comment_routes: Which conversation an NPC uses once a flag is set. Checked in order and the LAST match wins, so later entries are later in the story. Trainers are not listed here; encounters.json already routes those through their own afterDialogue.

$starterReads.bramblit: Bramble-backed hare. Tanky and slow, built to take the hit.
$starterReads.cindercub: Ash-furred fox kit. Fast and fragile, built to end things quick.
$starterReads.dewdrake: Dew-slick newt. Balanced and quick on its feet, no bad matchups.

$comment_starterReads: The one-line read StarterPicker shows on each starter's card. GAME_DESIGN.md section 6 has the source reads; these are trimmed to fit a card rather than quoted verbatim.
$comment: All spoken text, data driven. CLAUDE.md writing style: terse, grounded, no em dashes, no speeches. A node either advances via `next` or ends. `choices` branch. `effect` names a flag or action the DialogueRunner applies; the runner refuses any effect it does not recognise rather than failing silently.

start.text: You're going, then. I thought you might.

satchel.text: Satchel's packed. Axe, pick, knife, hammer. Everything I carried, and it did me fine.

orbs.text: Three Worn Pact Orbs. They were mine. They're yours now, and they're all you get from me.

hall.text: The Meadows Hall has been dark six years. Team Tether chained the pals inside it to run their lights.

east.text: It's east of here. Follow the road stub when you find it. You'll know the building.

five.text: One rule I'll hold you to. Five pals. Never six. You want a sixth, you let one go first, and you do it looking at them.

choose.text: I kept three back from my walking days. Take one.

picked.text: Good. Feed it, fight beside it, and don't get it killed to save yourself a walk.

practice.text: Tuftmoths in the grass past the fence. Throw an orb at one before you go.

end.text: Better you learn the throw here than at the Hall door. Go on. I'll be here.

start.text: Tuftmoths past the fence. Throw an orb at one, then go east.
That's two of them answering to you. Five is the ceiling. I meant it.

east.text: East now. The road stub picks up past the standing stones.

start.text: You cut them loose. All four.

sigil.text: That's a Meadow Sigil on your satchel. First of eight, if you've got the legs for it.

bench.text: Bracken's orb bench plans came back with you. Build one and you can make Truestone. You'll want them for what's north.

start.text: Tether came through in the spring. Took two of my grazehorns and left a receipt.
Standing stones south of here. Something big sits on them. Don't go at it with one pal.

warn.text: You've got orbs on your belt, so you think you're somebody. Let's log it.

start.text: Fine. Go up. Holt will sort you out.

warn.text: Nobody gets to the tether floor. Not even the ones who ask nicely.

start.text: Door's behind me. I'm not stopping you twice.
Six years I've kept this Hall. You're the first one to get past the door.

why.text: I was a ranger. I know what the collars do. I took the post so it wouldn't go to someone who didn't care.

collar.text: Don't waste an orb on my three. Collared pals don't answer a pact. It'll bounce.

fight.text: Cut the tethers if you can hold your five together. I'd rather it was you than the next one.

cut.text: Four go back to the grass. The big one has been down there eighteen levels' worth of angry.

sigil.text: Meadow Sigil. Take it. And the orb bench plans, they're no use to me now.

warn.text: Seven Halls left. The Steward runs them all and he does not take the job as gently as I did.

start.text: The collar is off. It watches you and does not leave.

left.text: It turns back toward the stones.
